data.title: Tap Global Expands Cryptocurrency Treasury to £800,000 Following Further Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana Purchases
data.description: Tap Global Group plc (LSE:TAP) has acquired an additional £235,523 worth of Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana as part of its Digital Asset Income Strategy (DAIS), bringing the total cost of its cryptocurrency and stablecoin treasury holdings to approximately £800,000. The regulated crypto-fintech company purchased three Bitcoin (BTC), ten Ethereum (ETH) and 500 Solana (SOL) tokens on 29 October 2026, following earlier acquisitions made between September and October.
